title: ilex dubia var. mollis
intro: Ilex dubia var. mollis, commonly known as a plant species within the family Aquifoliaceae, is a variant of the Ilex dubia plant. It is also known as the 'Indian Holly' or 'Ilex dubia variegated'. The leaves and other parts of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Ilex dubia var. mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
